__doc__: Runner concurrency / parallel-execution config (source of truth — NOT in .env). The N-slot drain pool (SOT-931/933) runs distinct serialization lanes concurrently while same-lane (=同一repo) work stays serial. Env vars still override at runtime when explicitly set: RUNNER_MAX_PARALLEL / RUNNER_SERIALIZE_SCOPE / RUNNER_STABLE_MODE.

__fields__.maxParallel: N-slot pool size: how many distinct repository lanes may run concurrently. Same-repository work remains serial.
__fields__.serializeScope: 'repo' (default: 同一repo直列・別repo並行) | 'branch' (別branchも別laneで並行可).
__fields__.stableMode: true forces fully-serial (maxParallel→1, scope→repo, no detach) — emergency kill-switch. Prefer the runtime env RUNNER_STABLE_MODE=1 for a temporary halt; keep this false as the committed steady state.
